message.content: The agent confirmed Flask/torch/transformers were installed, downloaded the DistilBERT SST-2 model to /app/model_cache/sentiment_model, wrote /app/app.py with a POST /sentiment endpoint, launched it in the background on 0.0.0.0:5000, and verified positive/negative and 400 error cases via urllib (curl unavailable), though the non-JSON body test failed due to a str-vs-bytes bug in the test script.
